scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The VC equality and all-size online lower bound have elementary proofs. Exact online upper bounds were checked exhaustively only for equal-arm lengths 1 through 12, using two enumerators and two implementations of the recursive decision-tree criterion. The first two-bit cardinality deficit is asserted only in this family, and no exact all-size Littlestone formula is claimed. No independent scientific audit or external certification has been performed.
title: First two-bit entropy obstruction for connected subtrees of three-arm spiders
